text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from its Period 7 peak, so earlier gains do not guarantee future stability; I should keep reviewing risk as conditions change.","Doing nothing avoids unnecessary trades, but several quiet months do not remove the need to check whether my holdings still fit my goal of preserving retirement savings.","I should avoid reacting to short-term price moves, and make measured changes only when they meaningfully reduce risk or keep my portfolio balanced."]}
